eyebrow: REST APIs & Integration Fundamentals · Chapter 2, Lesson 9
subtitle: Moving from reading data to writing it

steps.label: POST
steps.sub: to the collection URL — creates a brand-new record

steps.label: PATCH
steps.sub: to one record's own URL — updates only the fields you send

steps.label: Content-Type header
steps.sub: application/json — tells Fusion the body is JSON

code:
POST /fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/invoices
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "BusinessUnit": "US Business Unit",
  "InvoiceCurrency": "USD",
  "InvoiceDate": "2026-10-01",
  "Supplier": "Acme Supply Co",
  "SupplierSite": "ACME-US-01"
}
caption: A minimal create payload — real integrations typically include invoice lines too.

code:
PATCH /fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05
       /invoices/300000182
Content-Type: application/json

{ "Description": "Reissued per vendor request" }
caption: PATCH changes only the fields included — every other field on the invoice is untouched.
